purpose: Isolated experimental layer for Website Ventures hypotheses and interaction prototypes; accepted HQ decisions and real customer evidence stay separate.

sourceHierarchy.rule: Evidence can promote a Lab hypothesis into HQ; a Lab hypothesis never overwrites HQ by itself.

guardrails: No prospect calls, emails, DMs or form submissions from the Lab without Joey explicitly requesting outreach.
No fake reviews, client projects, certifications, staff identity or performance claims.
No paid Higgsfield/video generation credits are spent from autonomous Lab work.
Accepted Website Lab variants are preserved before a canonical variant is replaced.
Do not scale to students, salespeople or provinces before the first delivery and sales loop is proven.

activePrototype.visualReference: Product A: thin black-glass/chrome tablet over one large rough pale stone in a calm premium architectural world with restrained oxblood red.
activePrototype.motionReference: Higgsfield 3D Jutsu motion v7: friendly diagonal lift, controlled zoom, visible device edges, soft peak and return to the same stone.
experienceArchitecture: Cinematic same-stone tablet hero that becomes a real coded interface.
Three visually different coded showcase worlds plus a fourth Join the Club / Coming Soon slot.
Interactive website configurator with visible test pricing.
Optional contact CTA that never blocks the ending.
Cinematic close where the device settles back onto the same stone.
Subtle generic maker-guide placeholder; not represented as Joey's actual likeness.
interactionContract: Start with the tablet resting on the same large pale stone.
Scroll lifts the same tablet diagonally and rotates it toward upright with smooth interpolation.
At peak, the physical device edges remain visible.
The screen uses real coded HTML rather than generated fake UI.
Showcases must feel like different visual worlds rather than one recolored template.
Ads/product motion stays labelled as capability demo until genuine client proof exists.
Configurator pricing is a test hypothesis, not a binding quote.
Booking/contact is optional and never blocks continued scrolling.
The closing scene returns the same visual device to the same stone.

weekSprint.primaryOutcome: Own agency site visually strong and coherent, three distinct example websites represented in it, and at least one product/ad-motion example available.
weekSprint.assetWindow: Approximately four remaining days of the current Higgsfield Unlimited period per Joey's estimate; treat it as a targeted production sprint.
weekSprint.salesGate: Once own site plus three strong examples are good enough to show, do not build a fourth fictional demo before at least one real person has seen the offer or a real external test project has started.
weekSprint.reuseTarget: Roughly 70% reusable underlying system while color, copy, hero, motion, composition and information rhythm can vary substantially.

currentWorkingModel.offer: Premium-feeling websites for small businesses: visibly high-end and bespoke at a surprisingly reachable test price, with a reusable production system underneath.
currentWorkingModel.scope: Up to 3 core pages, one bundled revision round, mobile + desktop, contact flow, basic technical SEO/analytics and launch after complete intake.
currentWorkingModel.productization: Customer chooses or is guided through visual theme, hero direction, scroll/motion family, information flow and optional functionality; paid bespoke work remains possible when economics justify it.

evidenceGates.question: Does the finished presentation create a genuine wow reaction and a serious conversation?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Fix the offer/demo before adding more fictional showcase volume.

evidenceGates.question: Can Joey repeatedly close, deliver and support the founding offer while customers remain happy?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Do not hire or expand geography yet.

evidenceGates.question: Do customers report better trust, traction, conversion quality or other real business value?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Do not sell unsupported performance claims; improve product and measurement.

scaleGates: Delivery repeatedly at or below roughly 6 hours after complete intake.
At least three genuine customers/cases with usable feedback or proof.
A sales process with repeated observations sufficient to estimate conversion rather than guess it.
A reusable component/visual system another builder can follow without degrading quality.
